data.advice:
I’ll check the replay code, decision record, and cited evidence, then assess whether the proposed comparison can support a decision. I’ll be especially strict about the system requirements and what staggered entry dates can establish from one frozen price history.The supplied excerpts support testing whether a simpler portfolio can reproduce the result. They do not support treating staggered starts as independent regimes or drawdown as a shortcut around the return uncertainty. I also need to flag a limit: this session exposes no workspace or browsing tools, so I cannot independently verify the files or full papers. I’ll mark those gaps rather than invent line citations.The main system issue is the accounting rule: drawdown requires daily marked-to-market wealth, while the proposal says only realised net CNY counts. The new line needs an explicit, ledger-reconciled valuation rule. There is also an arithmetic inconsistency in the supplied power figures: scaling the 120-month MDE of 544.65 down to 259.32 gives about 529 months, rather than 369. Both imply decades, but the exact claim needs checking.1. **The problem is worth one bounded benchmark experiment.** The research user currently cannot tell whether the adopted construction adds value beyond an ordinary, implementable portfolio of the same sleeves. That uncertainty makes further construction work difficult to justify. Its demonstrated cost is research effort and an unresolved architectural claim; this project has no live capital.

   The proposed experiment could support a practical retirement decision: if a simpler policy reproduces the observed outcome, stop maintaining the extra construction. It cannot establish a durable risk product merely by changing the metric from mean return to drawdown. The reported near match between the adopted return and 510300’s return also needs an executable comparison: a return computed directly from adjusted bars is not yet a benchmark with the same capital, whole lots, cash, and fees.

   This review uses the supplied passages. This session exposes no filesystem or browsing tools, so I could not perform the requested full reads or verify source lines. Findings below are explicitly unanchored where the supplied text provides no verifiable location.

2. **Cannot judge the six individual decision rounds — because their handoff and decision records are unavailable here.** The excerpts permit the following narrower reconstruction, with source paths identified by the caller but line locations unverified.

   The E2 work compared volatility and fitted-rule policies against their baseline. The reported rule result was +259.32 CNY/year with an interval crossing zero and MDE 544.65; the volatility arm had still larger noise. The execution decomposition matters: 36 months had no intended tilt, 12 had an intended tilt entirely blocked by the gate, and 72 executed it. This teaches that estimation, intended allocation, and realised implementation are different objects. It does not establish that a return source does not exist. Reported sources: `evidence/e2-summary.json`, `newquant/replay.py:462–524`, and `newquant/eval/e2.py:89–135`; these locations remain unverified.

   The reported power arithmetic also needs reconciliation. Holding the variance and test threshold fixed, the usual scaling gives \(120(544.65/259.32)^2 \approx 529\) months for the MDE to reach the point estimate, rather than 369. Either result implies decades, so this discrepancy does not rescue the return experiment.

   The E3 work compared the lot construction with static and cash alternatives under implementation constraints. The supplied 50,000-CNY result reports adopted wealth of 85,111.30 versus 62,163.64 for static, alongside substantially different entry cash fractions. This establishes an observed account-level difference, conditional on reproduction. It does not isolate its cause. Reported source: `evidence/e3-summary.json`.

   The mandate ablation reported all five contrasts: full +1,542.8; no commodity +959.7; no overseas +742.8; neither −19.6; no bond +1,773.4 CNY/year. The near disappearance without commodity and overseas demonstrates that those sleeves are necessary for the observed lots-minus-static contrast in this experiment. It does **not** prove that sleeve returns account additively for the entire gain: removing sleeves can change rounding, cash, gate decisions, and the baseline itself. The reported collapse of the no-bond static arm reinforces that attribution problem. Reported source: `evidence/probe-ablation/summary.json`.

   The earlier frontier line reportedly closed `blocked` after six rounds. Without `.quant/handoff/etf-implementable-frontier.md`, I cannot distinguish its individual rejected hypotheses, decision rules, and surviving conclusions.

3. **The closest intellectual prior is simple-policy benchmarking, more directly than rebalancing-premium theory.** A relevant published comparison is DeMiguel, Garlappi and Uppal, “Optimal Versus Naive Diversification: How Inefficient Is the 1/N Portfolio Strategy?”, *Review of Financial Studies* 22(5), 1915–1953, DOI [10.1093/rfs/hhm075](https://doi.org/10.1093/rfs/hhm075). Its central question is whether estimated portfolio methods improve on simple diversification when evaluated out of sample, including risk-adjusted performance and turnover. That is closer to “does this construction earn its complexity?” than an account of rebalancing returns. It does not settle the whole-lot, commission-floor problem in this venue.

   For drawdown specifically, Chekhlov, Uryasev and Zabarankin, “Drawdown Measure in Portfolio Optimization,” *International Journal of Theoretical and Applied Finance* 8(1), 13–58 (2005), DOI [10.1142/S0219024905002767](https://doi.org/10.1142/S0219024905002767), is a more direct methodological reference. Drawdown is an established portfolio risk objective. Its use does not make one realised path sufficient for inference about future regimes. These are bibliographic pointers, not newly verified full-text dispositions.

   The caller’s other references remain relevant to narrower questions. Rebalancing-premium work concerns the consequences of changing weights through time; it becomes less explanatory when the account largely holds its initial purchases. Baule and Altarovici–Muhle-Karbe–Soner concern portfolio implementation under fixed costs. Leippold–Wang–Zhou and Brandt–Santa-Clara–Valkanov concern estimation and portfolio policies that this adopted path reportedly does not use. Their exact results require the outstanding full-text checks.

   The closest operational precedent is the workspace’s own `probe/ablation_e3.py`: the proposed experiment changes controls and evaluation while retaining the execution mechanism. Whether its machinery genuinely supports arbitrary starts remains unverified.

4. **A contribution could land as a reproducible simplification result or a narrowly demonstrated constraint effect.** Neither requires a new portfolio model.

   A useful simplification result would show that one fixed policy, chosen before examining the new results, reproduces the adopted account’s return and risk within declared tolerances under identical implementation rules. That would resolve an actual project decision and correct the contribution record.

   A stronger constraint result would isolate why lot arithmetic improves the feasible allocation: the same sleeve opportunity set, controlled cash treatment, identical fees, and a demonstrated mechanism linking indivisible purchases to the difference. Merely beating two arbitrarily chosen mixes would establish only that those two mixes failed.

   The matched-return condition must be an evaluation rule, not a method of choosing weights after seeing each outcome. The same fixed rule must apply across starts, or selection between rules must depend only on information available at entry. More cash is a legitimate allocation choice, but a claim about allocation skill needs controls that distinguish sleeve selection from reduced exposure. Equal average invested fraction alone does not establish that distinction.

   The available tape can support a conditional result about these accounts and dates. It cannot establish durability across market regimes. It also cannot validate the promised panel-to-combiner interface if that interface does not affect the adopted orders.

5. **Retire the construction if one prespecified, feasible fixed policy reproduces its result across the declared comparison grid.** Concretely, the alternative should achieve terminal net wealth within a preregistered return tolerance, with drawdown and volatility no worse beyond preregistered risk tolerances, at each tested capital, entry date, and horizon. Feasibility, cash, and costs must be accounted for identically. Choosing a different winner after observing each start would not meet this condition.

   I would abandon the stronger “risk reduction at matched return” claim if its advantage disappears against executable references once cash and return tolerances are enforced—for example, if every apparent drawdown improvement is purchased through a material return shortfall, or a simpler bond-heavy policy dominates it.

   A successful simplification result would complete this experiment. It would end the case for retaining the construction, rather than refute the decision to run the audit.

6. **A system can probably deliver the descriptive audit with the existing data; the claimed time budget and inferential conclusion are not yet established.**

   The single requirement that forces the design is **one explicit, ledger-reconciled definition of account wealth**. Daily drawdown and volatility require valuing open positions. Realised cash P&L alone cannot describe an account’s economic drawdown. If “only realised net CNY counts” excludes marked holdings entirely, the proposed risk comparison is impossible under that rule. If it governs the economic decision while permitting marked-to-market risk diagnostics, record that interpretation as part of the new line.

   The probe must therefore specify daily valuation, treatment of entry and terminal costs, and the relationship between marked wealth and realised proceeds. It must also distinguish fixed initial purchases held thereafter from fixed target weights submitted monthly to the gate: these are different policies.

   Before running the matrix, freeze the weight rules, return and risk tolerances, missing-data treatment, infeasibility rules, and decision criterion. Reproduce +1,542.8 using the original configuration and statistic; reconcile holdings, cash, fees, and relevant execution counts as well. With no git history, save source hashes, configuration, and data manifests beside the new evidence. An unavailable ETF or unaffordable required lot must produce an explicit infeasibility result.

   The proposed budget counts only 60 cells: 12 starts × five arms. Testing both 50,000 and 100,000 CNY makes 120 cells before any additional horizon runs. Five-year summaries can potentially share simulation prefixes, but actual terminal-liquidation branches need explicit treatment. At “minutes per cell,” an under-hour run needs measured evidence of reuse or parallelism. Time one representative cell before committing to that promise. Conclusions should cover tested capitals only; lot feasibility is discontinuous between them.

   Finally, staggered starts test sensitivity to entry timing. They do not separate the construction from the market regime: most accounts encounter the same gold rally, Nasdaq rally, and drawdown events. A deterministic comparison can justify simplifying this project without treating those accounts as independent samples.

### Evaluation of the Four Objections and Responses (Contribution Emphasis)

1. **R1 (Valuation & Risk Measurement — Resolved in mechanism, requires explicit metric binding in the spec):**
   Pointing to the replay engine's daily mark-to-market series (`newquant/replay.py:807-808`, exposed as `ReplayResult.daily` at `newquant/replay.py:533`) **resolves the technical blocker**: the engine already prices open holdings at every session via `book.nav(marks)` alongside `book.cash`, while keeping the append-only ledger strictly for realised fills. To keep this from slipping back into an ambiguity, the design spec must state explicitly that drawdown and volatility are computed on `ReplayResult.daily["nav"]` (`book.nav(marks)`) and that "net CNY" at horizon end is `nav_T - nav_0` on that same mark-to-market basis (or after a forced terminal liquidation pass).

2. **R2 (Single-Regime Path vs. Cross-Regime Superiority — Restatement for positive claims; resolved only by narrowing to a one-sided retirement test):**
   The claim that *"A drawdown comparison is decidable from one window because the quantity is not a mean-return difference"* is a **restatement rather than a resolution**. Twelve monthly starts within one 2,430-session window share ~80–95% of the same realised macro path (in which gold returned 15.3%/yr and Nasdaq 19.6%/yr) and cannot establish regime-invariant superiority on drawdown any more than on mean return. **What evidence would have counted** for a positive durability claim: disjoint regime windows or block-bootstrapped/synthetic path stress tests where commodity and overseas sleeves draw down simultaneously. However, under the **narrowed direction**, the contribution is a **one-sided falsification check (Kill Criterion 4)**: you do not need cross-regime proof to *retire* a construction that fails to beat a simpler fixed-lot or hold-to-end benchmark on the very path where its gain was measured.

3. **R3 (Ablation Attribution vs. Comparator Deterioration — Restatement in the brief; resolved only by running the reconciled attribution in the pilot):**
   Asserting from the ablation contrast alone that commodity and overseas sleeves *"are the entire measured gain"* is a **restatement rather than a resolution**. In `newquant/replay.py:506-507`, both `static` and `lots` target the exact same `dict(MANDATE)` weights on initial and annual rebalance dates; the +1,542.8 CNY `lots - static` gap therefore conflates sleeve returns with `static` arm lot-rounding failures, cost-gate suppressions, and idle cash drag. **What evidence would have counted**: a reconciled decomposition across `lots`, `static`, and a hold-to-end arm using the diagnostics already wired in `newquant/eval/e3.py:238-241` (`_sleeve_diagnostic`, `_sleeve_table`, `_entry_realisation`, and `_idle_cash_drag`). Supplying the hold-to-end arm and fixed-exposure benchmarks under identical implementation rules—and reporting that attribution table—turns R3 from a fatal gap in the past claim into the exact measurement the pilot produces.

4. **R4 (Runtime Budget & Horizon Reuse — Moved rather than resolved until capital grid and horizon slicing are fixed):**
   Saying *"At most 12 entry dates x 5 compositions x 2430 sessions ... minutes per cell, so a probe budget under an hour"* **moves the objection rather than resolving it**: 60 cells at "minutes per cell" (e.g., 2 min/cell = 120 min) already exceeds 60 minutes before multiplying by capital levels (`nav0` across 50,000–100,000 CNY) or running separate 5-year and full-window replays. **What evidence would have counted**: quoting the measured per-cell wall time already logged at `newquant/eval/e3.py:251` (`out["seconds"]`), fixing `nav0` to the specific capital level(s) under test, and computing the 5-year horizon metrics by slicing `ReplayResult.daily` (`newquant/replay.py:533`, `808`) from the full-window run so the 5-year horizon adds zero `replay()` calls.

### Is the Narrowed Direction Worth the Pilot Budget?

**Yes—as a strict retirement/falsification gate on the single realised path.** From a contribution standpoint, `newquant/replay.py:506-507` shows that the shipped `lots` arm already has zero estimation (it targets fixed `dict(MANDATE)` weights at entry and annual rebalance). Spending under an hour of compute to compare `lots` (annual rebalance) against a hold-to-end arm (`prev is None` only) and 2–3 hand-fixed lot compositions under identical gate and fee rules directly tests Kill Criterion 4. If a hold-to-end or hand-fixed lot mix matches `lots` on `book.nav(marks)` drawdown and net CNY across the 12 starts, the dynamic/rebalancing construction is retired immediately.

findings.response: CONCEDED, and the rule is now a measurement rather than a promise. The requirement to state one valuation rule is accepted. The rule: mark to the session's own mark every session via book.nav(marks_at(sess)) — the single NAV writer invariant I-1 already declares — carrying cash and every held lot, including lots a T+1 sell cannot yet release; no interpolation between marks, no separate 'unrealised' series, no exclusion of open positions. This is not a new accounting layer: the engine already writes it and the evidence throws it away. newquant/replay.py:807-808 appends {'date','nav','cash'} once per session into daily_rows, ReplayResult.daily at newquant/replay.py:532 carries the 2430-row frame, and E2/E3 persist only result.monthly, which is why every published risk number in this project is a monthly-marked one. Measured on the adopted cell (nav 50,000, tol 15.1 bp, cost measured, 2430 sessions): lots arm daily-marked drawdown -14.50% versus monthly-marked -12.27%, so the shipped number understates the drawdown by 2.23 pp; static -20.97% versus -19.17%, understated by 1.80 pp. The economic drawdown was therefore always computable and was under-reported. Second half of the objection conceded more sharply than it was put: the two policies named are BOTH absent. static is not a fixed initial purchase held to the end — compose() returns dict(MANDATE) at each annual decision, so static re-submits the mandate every January and the gate then refuses most of it. No arm in this workspace buys once at entry and never submits again, which is exactly the arm the project's own kill criterion 4 needs in order to be evaluable. The pilot therefore adds one prespecified arm, hold: enter whole lots once on the entry date at the mandate's weights as rounded by the same lot rule, then submit nothing for the remaining sessions.

The ablation does not isolate sleeve return: evidence/probe-ablation/summary.json shows the no_bond variant moving the CONTROL itself from static 62,163.64 to 55,303 while the lots arm moves to 79,052, so removing one sleeve changes the comparator's own trajectory and the +1,542.8 CNY delta is a contrast between two different books, not an additive sleeve contribution. data.statement: On the realised 2016-2025 path, test whether the adopted lot-defined five-sleeve composition is reproducible by one prespecified feasible fixed policy under identical gate and fee rules, scoring terminal net CNY and daily-marked drawdown with the entry date varied, so that the construction has to earn its complexity against something an investor could actually hold.
data.problem: The adopted lot-defined book has no evidence that it beats an ordinary implementable alternative of the same sleeves. The only measured contrast (+1,542.8 CNY/yr vs the static arm) is a contrast against a comparator that re-submits the mandate annually and is itself changed by removing sleeves, and every published risk number is monthly-marked, understating drawdown by 1.8-2.2 pp. So the question the project can now answer is which prespecified feasible fixed policy reproduces the adopted account's terminal net CNY within a preregistered tolerance, with daily-marked drawdown and volatility no worse beyond preregistered tolerances, on the realised 2016-2025 path, with the entry date varied — and if one does, the construction is retired in favour of it.
data.difference: The previous idea measured whether a timing rule (vol or z-score tilt) beats buy-and-hold on mean net CNY, and died of statistical power at this capital (MDE 545-1,750 CNY against a 375 bar; 30.8 years to resolution). This idea does not measure a mean-return edge at all: it measures whether the construction is *reproducible by something simpler* under identical implementation rules — a one-sided retirement test scored on daily-marked drawdown and terminal net CNY rather than on mean-return significance. That flips what counts as evidence: an unmeasurable mean difference no longer decides it, and a fixed policy landing inside a declared band on every entry date does.
data.learn: If a hold arm or one hand-fixed lot mix lands inside the return tolerance and no worse on daily drawdown across all twelve entry starts, the lot-rule and annual re-submission earn nothing the simpler policy does not, and the shipped construction is retired in favour of the simpler one — a result the project can act on this year. If instead the adopted arm is outside the band at most starts, the construction has a measured reason to exist on this path for the first time, and the next round is a reconciled attribution of where the difference comes from (sleeve price return, cash drag, rounding term), not another significance test. What would change my mind: an entry start where no hand-fixed mix is feasible at all, which would say the comparison is not defined at low capital rather than that the construction wins.
data.minimalTest: A unit test on the new hold arm asserting no fill after the entry session, plus a single replay of hold against lots at the one recorded entry start 2016-01-04 / nav 50,000 / tol 15.1 / measured. If hold's terminal net CNY lands within the preregistered return tolerance of lots and its daily-marked drawdown is no worse, the machinery is already unnecessary at that start and the twelve-start grid is not worth running.

data.subject: Which measurement the next round spends on, after the direction/architecture/completion review
data.decision: The next round is NOT another significance test on a mean-return edge. It is a prespecified reproduction test: on the realised 2016-01-04..2025-12-31 path, with 12 entry dates, score the adopted lot-defined book against (i) a new hold arm that buys whole lots once at entry and never submits again, (ii) two hand-fixed feasible lot mixes, (iii) buy-and-hold 510300 and 511220 on the qfq series, all under the same 15.1 bp gate, the same etf_std fee profile, and the same engine; report terminal net CNY plus DAILY-marked drawdown and volatility, and report entry-date dispersion as entry sensitivity, not as a regime distribution. The retirement rule is fixed before the run: if one prespecified fixed policy lands inside the declared return tolerance on terminal net CNY and is no worse on daily drawdown and volatility beyond the declared risk tolerances at every entry start, the lot-rule and annual re-submission are retired in favour of it. Idea recorded as etf-composition-carries-the-risk v2, design v2, all eleven design fields carrying a condition and a measure.
data.rationale: The review established four things that together decide the round. (1) The library the project ships is a risk product, not a return product: the adopted book's daily-marked numbers are cagr 6.01 %, vol 9.09 %, maxDD -14.50 % (Sharpe 0.66) against one broad ETF at 5.47 % / 21.76 % / -44.75 % (0.25) — a 32.5 pp drawdown cut for about 0.5 pp of return — so the mean-return question the previous six review rounds argued about was never the project's own claim. (2) That question cannot be settled at this capital anyway: the rule arm's MDE is 544.65 CNY/yr against a 375 bar, and even restricted to the 84 months with a live tilt the MDE rises to 776.97 and needs 369 months (30.8 years) to reach the point estimate. (3) The construction's own edge is unmeasured against the comparison that matters: the ablation shows the lot rule adds nothing without commodity and overseas (-19.6 CNY/yr with both removed), and removing bond moves the static comparator from 62,163.64 to 55,303, so the +1,542.8 is a bundle (sleeves supply the return, the lot rule supplies access) rather than an additive sleeve contribution. (4) Every risk number published so far is monthly-marked while the engine writes a per-session NAV that is discarded, so the drawdown was understated by 1.80 pp (static) and 2.23 pp (lots); the economic drawdown was therefore always computable, which removes the blocker the first review round raised against measuring it. A retirement test needs none of the power the significance test lacked: it is one-sided, it asks a question with an actionable answer either way, and it is the test the project's own §9 kill criterion 4 demands and has never had an artifact for. Review outcome invest/explore with all four objections accepted; gpt-6.1-sol held the pilot on a packet artefact (its brief showed the four answer fields as null) while gemini4high judged R1 resolved and R2/R3 non-blocking once the causal claim is withdrawn — the disagreement is recorded, not averaged away.
data.applicability: Holds while the data window, the venue table and the 15.1 bp gate are the ones recorded here; a different window, a larger instrument set, or a capital above 250,000 CNY changes what the comparison can conclude and reopens the question. The conclusion licensed is retirement or survival of the construction on this path — it licenses no claim about other regimes and no claim of mean-return superiority.
evidence: .quant/ledger.jsonl seq 146 (idea v2, design v2, designUncheckable empty)
data.remainingRisk: The retirement rule has tolerances (return tolerance, risk tolerance) that must be fixed BEFORE the run or the test can be steered after seeing numbers; and the 12 entry dates share one tape, so a policy that wins on all twelve may be winning on the 2016-2025 gold and Nasdaq path rather than on its construction. Both are declared limits, not things the probe can fix.
data.verifyPlan: The probe must first reproduce the recorded 2016-01-04 lots-versus-static delta of +1,542.79 CNY/yr and the ledger head from evidence/e3-ledgers/; a mismatch aborts with invalid_experiment. Then the cheapest kill is the single-start hold-versus-lots replay: if hold already lands inside the return tolerance with no worse daily drawdown at that one start, the twelve-start grid is not worth running.
data.reopenCondition: A pre-existing simpler policy that the probe never tested because no hand-fixed lot mix was feasible at low capital; or a change to the daily-mark basis (T+0/T+1 release rule, mark source) that moves the drawdown comparison; or a capital level where the lot term stops binding, which changes the question from which composition to which weights.

data.decisionRule: 复现闸门（不过即 invalid_experiment，任何臂的数字不得引用）：static 终值 62 163.64 ±0.01、成交 6 笔、链头 db6a4f19b62d1e75…；lots 终值 85 111.21；deltas['lots-static'].annual_cny = 1 542.79 ±0.05。判定常数（写死在脚本顶部、跑前定、之后不改）：RETURN_TOL = 2% of lots 终值（|hold_end/lots_end − 1| ≤ 0.02）；RISK_TOL = 1.0 pp（日频 maxDD 不比 lots 差超过 1.0 pp，日频年化波动不比 lots 高超过 1.0 pp）。单向读法：任一 hold 臂在此起点两项任一不过 → 该臂的"退场"假设在此起点被否，构造在此起点有实测的存在理由，但这只是 1/12 个起点；任一 hold 臂两项都过 → 不构成退场证据（12 起点全过才判退场），只说明网格必须跑。预期：hold（MANDATE）因闲置现金而必然不过，hold_deploy（整手组合 + 再分配 + 冻结）才是有意义的对手，它决定"年度再提交"是否赚到东西。
data.notes: confirm 步（判定规则跑前写定）。窗口早已被读过多次，故按 screen 角色登记，不作 final claim。单格成本约 30 s；网格 120 格约 46 min，只有单格不能settle时才跑。同时记录一个与 handoff 的分歧：docs/review-2026-11-05.md:117 写"若 hold 已落在复现带内且日频回撤不差，直接判构造退场"，这与 §4.1 自己声明的"要求在全部 12 个入场日上都成立"矛盾——单起点通过不能判退场，只能判"该起点不构成退场证据"。

data.subject: hold-kill 单格判读：退场方向被否，但原因与预注册假设相反——楔子在入场组成，年度再提交贡献 ≈0 或负
data.decision: 复现判据三条臂全部落在 2% 带外（终值比 lots：hold 0.6866、hold_lot 1.1458、hold_deploy 1.2766），故"简单政策复现采用账本→构造退场"在此起点被否。但不复现的原因不是构造在赚钱：hold_lot 与 lots 的入场账本逐项相同（入场现金同为 19.57%、同样 5 笔建仓、入场成本同为 29.55 CNY），只少 9 笔年度再提交成交，终值却高 12,405.59 CNY（+14.58%），日频 vol 9.04% vs 9.14%、maxDD −14.28% vs −14.50%。固定名义口径下年度再提交 − ors：hold_lot−lots = +669.55 CNY/yr（lo 22.62 / hi 1,250.21，MDE 1,210.34，即低于其自身 MDE，方向为"冻结更好"）。唯一清过 MDE 的单一杠杆是入场组成：hold_lot−hold = +2,591.33 CNY/yr（lo 1,483.91 / hi 3,550.61，MDE 1,965.15），远大于 lots−static 的 +1,542.79 → E3 记录的整个楔子归给"入场时把 commodity+overseas 真的买进去"（lots 入场投出 80.4%，static 只 62.6%，因 15.1bp 的 min-commission 地板把小额袖整袖拒掉）。
data.rationale: 机制：lots 场后 9 笔维护成交中 6 笔卖出 31,094.7 CNY、3 笔买入 26,112.4 CNY，十年后现金占 24.79%（hold_lot 15.50%），overseas 从入场 9.86% 只漂到 10.29% 而 hold_lot 漂到 29.29%、commodity 6.56% vs 20.98% → 年度再提交是一个去风险单向棘轮（卖出走 i+1 单腿易过闸，买入走 i+2 逐单受 min-commission 约束）。但 hold_lot 的 +14.58% 集中 2023-2025（+6,847.79；2016-2022 合计 −151.34），且完全由 overseas 权重承载 → 是路径性质不是政策性质；12 个重叠入场起点共享同一路径，分离不了。另：两臂 maxDD 都在 14.4% 附近却发生在不同事件（lots 2018-12-26、hold_lot 2022-10-28），"风险相同"是数值巧合而非暴露相同，故后续比较必须报回撤发生时段，不能只报数值。会改变判读的观察：在闸门不绑定的条件下（放开的 gate 或更大资本）年度再提交不再为负，则本结论作废，问题转为资本/闸门而非政策。
data.applicability: 50 000 CNY、15.1 bp、measured 费率、起点 2016-01-04、窗口至 2025-12-31、日频标记口径（sd×sqrt252、财富序列含 nav0）。不得外推到其他起点或其他资本。
data.remainingRisk: 本次只跑了一个入场起点；"+14.58%"与"年度再提交为负"都建立在这一条 2016-2025 路径上，且优势年份集中在最后三年。若把它当成政策结论，就是把一段美股+黄金顺风当成了机制。
data.verifyPlan: 把同一对臂在放宽闸门（tolerance 200 bp）的 2×2 里重跑约 15 秒：若 lots 与 hold 的差距在开放闸门下塌到 2% 内，则损失属于闸门而非政策。
data.reopenCondition: 开放闸门（或更大资本使 min-commission 不再是约束）后，lots 相对 hold 的差距收窄到 2% 带内或转为正。

data.hypothesis: adopted lots 相对冻结账本的损失来自 15.1 bp 闸门（卖出走 i+1 单腿易过，买入走 i+2 逐单被 min-commission 地板拒 → 现金升到 24.79%、overseas 被削），而不是"年度再提交"这个政策本身。放开闸门后 lots 与 hold 的差距应收窄。
data.decisionRule: 2×2 设计（闸门 × 是否维护），同一 50 000 CNY、同一 measured 费率、同一窗口：A=lots@15.1（已测 85,111.30）、B=hold@15.1（已测 58,436.38）、C=lots@200、D=hold@200。判据写在跑前：若 |C/D − 1| ≤ 2% 则闸门是约束、维护在闸门不绑定时中性（损失归闸门，fix 指向资本/闸门而非停止再提交）；若 C/D > 1.02（维护在开放闸门下仍赢）则维护本身有价值、先前结论作废并回到政策问题；若 C/D < 0.98（维护在开放闸门下仍输）则年度再提交在两条闸门水平上都毁值，方向转为"不修剪"。附：200 bp 同时改变入场（9 只全买）与维护，故这是 2×2 而非单旋钮隔离，读数按 2×2 解释；若 robustness 需要单旋钮隔离，另立实验加 tolerance_bp_entry/maintenance 两个参数。
data.notes: explore→confirm 之间的诊断步：目的不是评估政策而是定位损失来源（闸门 vs 政策）。约 15 秒两臂。预期看到 tolerance 200 时 suppressions 归零，否则该臂读数无效（脚本会打印抑制计数）。

data.subject: 闸门 vs 政策已分离：adopted 的贡献是可表达性，不是维护；开放闸门下冻结组合四项全不差
data.decision: 2×2 实测（四格全跑，45 s）：15.1 bp 下 lots 85,111.30 / hold 58,436.38；200 bp 下 lots 85,709.42 / hold 87,755.88（hold 抑制 0 次）。判据第三支命中：lots/hold = 0.9767（1000 bp 下 0.9741），即两种闸门水平下年度再瞄准都在毁值。hold@200 相对 adopted lots@15.1 高 +3.11%（同闸门水平高 +2.33%），且日频 vol 8.71% 对 10.59%、maxDD −13.65% 对 −17.19%、持续成本 0.90 对 5.66 bp/yr，三项同时更好。修正 seq 154：hold@15.1 不是冻结政策的合法比较对象——它入场只买进 510300/510500/511220（投出 59.1%），overseas 与 commodity 全程为 0，因为 1,565-2,460 CNY 的小单边际成本 21.8-35.8 bp 全被 15.1 bp 闸门拒掉；它的 −31% 度量的是"闸门整袖拒付"，不是"冻结"。adopted 账本 +1,542.79 CNY/yr 的正确归因由"lot 定义+年度维护赚到钱"改为"在 15.1 bp 门槛下只有先重写组成才能把这本书买进去"：lot_composition 减成员换取可表达性；一旦允许 naive 组合付它实际需要的一次性约 20 CNY（21-36 bp 小单）入场成本，naive 冻结组合在收益、vol、回撤、成本四项上都不更差。
data.rationale: 闸门在 1000 bp 下仍未"自由"：lots 剩 38 次抑制全是 zero_lot（17 买 21 卖，平均每年 3.8 次），即"每年重设到 45/35/10/10"这个意图在 50 000 元下连表达都做不到，剩下的约束是整手粒度而非成本。这也说明修 replay.py:804 的 i+1 卖/i+2 买不对称不能当作价值修复（闸门放开后差距依旧），只能当作比较前提。限制与每一条同读：hold@200 的优势仍由 overseas 10%→20.5%、commodity 10%→23.8% 的漂移承载，2022 年黄金对冲让它同时拿到更低回撤——这是 2016-2025 这条路径的性质，12 个重叠起点共享同一路径，分离不了"组成"与"顺风"。
data.applicability: 50 000 CNY、measured 费率、2016-01-04 起点、至 2025-12-31、日频标记口径。闸门三水平（15.1/200/1000 bp）已实测；不覆盖其他资本与其他起点。
data.remainingRisk: 两处未测：(a) naive 组合的入场成本一次性付 20 CNY 之后，"不修剪"在 2022 这类全跌年份靠的是黄金漂移，若黄金不涨则结论反转；(b) 1000 bp 下仍存在的 38 次 zero_lot 说明"每年重设到 45/35/10/10"在本资本下不是一个可执行的规则而是一个意图，任何"它赚了多少"的读数都混着取整伪影。
data.verifyPlan: 换一条不含 2023-2025 单边顺风的窗口（数据覆盖 2013-01-04 起，可试 2015-01-05..2019-12-31）重跑同一 2×2 四格，约 50 s：若 hold@200 仍不低于 lots@200，则"可表达性而非维护"得到独立支持。
data.reopenCondition: 在别的窗口（不同资产类赢家，例如没有 2023-2025 美股+黄金顺风的样本）上，开放闸门后的冻结不再优于再瞄准；或闸门 15.1 bp 被证明不是这个资本下的真实约束（真实小单成本可低到 15 bp 以内）。

data.hypothesis: 若"年度再瞄准在毁值、贡献在可表达性"是政策性质而非 2023-2025 顺风的产物，则在 2015-01-05..2019-12-31 这条资产类赢家不同的窗口上，开放闸门后冻结组合（hold@200）依旧不低于再瞄准组合（lots@200）。
data.decisionRule: 独立窗口检验 seq 157 的主结论。跑同一 2×2（lots/hold × 15.1/200 bp）在 2015-01-05..2019-12-31（含 2015 股灾、2016 熔断、2018 熊市；不含 2023-2025 美股+黄金顺风）。判据写在跑前：若 hold@200 ≥ lots@200（比值 ≥ 0.98）则"冻结不差于再瞄准、贡献在可表达性"得到独立支持；若 hold@200 / lots@200 < 0.98 则 2016-2025 的读数属路径性质，结论必须收窄为"只在 2020 后顺风窗口成立"。附：该窗口 512100（2016-11 才有）与 511380（2020-04 才有）缺席，equity 袖在 2015-2016 只能靠 510300/510500，bond 袖只有 511220——成员缺失会同时改变两臂的入场，故读比值不读绝对值；hold@15.1 若又如期出现"整袖拒付"，则它在此窗口同样不是合法比较对象，只作对照打印。
data.notes: explore 步（用独立窗口试探 seq 157 的适用边界，不是评估采用）。约 50 秒四格。

data.subject: 独立窗口把"冻结优势"翻成 −6.7%：构造的理由是可表达性，年度再提交是未决项
data.decision: 2015-01-05..2019-12-31（1 219 session，含 2015 股灾、2016 熔断、2018 熊市）同 2×2 加 hold_lot 六格。三条在两窗口上都成立：(1) 闸门不绑定时四种政策几乎同一：2015-19 三格 61,919.84 / 62,350.07 / 62,404.94 相差 0.79%，2016-25 两格相差 2.33% → 组成与维护都是二阶项。(2) 15.1 bp 下 naive 组合买不进两个袖：hold@15.1 两窗口 overseas 与 commodity 均 0.00%、现金 39.89%/40.76%，相对 hold@200 低 11.1%（2015-19）与 33.4%（2016-25）→ 在 50 000 元上"把组成重写成买得进的形状"是前提不是优化。(3) 冻结 vs 受闸门约束的再瞄准符号会翻：入场账本完全相同的两臂，hold_lot/lots = 1.1458（2016-25，冻结赢 14.6%）与 0.9334（2015-19，冻结输 6.7%），而风险几乎相同（maxDD −27.80% 对 −27.80%、vol 13.52% 对 13.49%）→ "年度再提交在毁值"不能作政策结论。收紧后可说的：闸门只放行漂移最大的腿，被放行的那几条之后是否继续跑决定它是成本还是收益，故维护是未决项而非构造的价值来源；lots − static = +1,542.79 CNY/yr 不能再读作维护收益。
data.rationale: seq 157 里 hold_lot 的 +14.58% 被当作"维护毁值"的证据，同一结构在独立窗口反向（−6.66%），说明该数值是 2016-01-04 这个入场起点与 2023-2025 顺风的函数，而不是政策属性。两窗口唯一稳定的、量级大的量是闸门对可表达性的作用（11%/33%），而它恰是项目原命题"组成承载风险"。判据上：预注册的 hold@200 ≥ lots@200（≥0.98）命中，实测 0.99912，故"冻结不低于再瞄准"在自由闸门下成立；但预注册没预料到的是 hold_lot 反向，这属于新事实而非判据失败。会改变判读的观察：若在第三、第四条窗口（如 2020-01-02..2026-11-04，数据已覆盖）上 hold_lot/lots 依旧同向，则符号翻转来自窗口长度而非趋势结构。
data.remainingRisk: 两窗口长度不同（5 年 vs 10 年），且 2015-2019 的入场点正好在 2015 年泡沫顶附近——冻结臂把 2015-06 的峰值权重一直带到 2019，这可能放大了它的落后。若只读比值，此点无法与"趋势结构不同"区分。
data.verifyPlan: 同六格在 2020-01-02..2026-11-04（含 2020 熔断、2021 黄金顶、2022 全跌、2023-2026 顺风，且 511380 从 2020-04 可用）重跑约 20 s：若 hold_lot/lots 再次 >1，则符号由趋势结构而非窗口长度决定。
data.reopenCondition: 第三/第四条窗口上 hold_lot/lots 与 2016-2025 同向且同量级（即冻结稳定赢），则本结论回到"维护毁值"，并需重新解释 2015-2019 的反向。

data.hypothesis: 若"冻结 vs 再瞄准"的符号由趋势结构而非窗口长度决定，则在 2020-01-02..2026-11-04（另一组资产类赢家：2020 成长股、2021 黄金顶、2022 全跌、2023-2026 美股+黄金）上，hold_lot/lots 应与 2016-2025 同向。
data.decisionRule: 第三条窗口，判"冻结 vs 受闸门约束的再瞄准"的符号是由趋势结构还是由窗口长度决定。跑 lots/hold/hold_lot × 15.1/200 bp 六格于 2020-01-02..2026-11-04（含 2020-03 熔断、2021 黄金顶、2022 全跌、2023-2026 顺风；该窗口终点 2026-11-04 超出 REPLAY_END 2025-12-31，仅作诊断不进入评估）。判据写在跑前：若 hold_lot/lots > 1.02 则符号与 2016-2025 同向、由趋势结构决定，seq 160 的"未决项"读法作废、回到"维护毁值"；若 0.98 ≤ 比值 ≤ 1.02 则两窗口之间就是平局，维护确为二阶项；若 < 0.98 则两条长窗口都不支持冻结，符号由 2023-2025 段决定而非窗口长度。同时报告 lead 两格的闸门可表达性（hold@15.1 的 overseas/commodity 是否仍为 0）。
data.notes: explore 步：符号稳定性检验，不是评估采用。约 20 秒六格。终点 2026-11-04 属面板内但超出 REPLAY_END，只作诊断。

data.subject: 第三窗口把冻结判负（−4.9%），且顶上 2026 这 10 个月就足以翻转：维护是噪声，可表达性是唯一稳定项
data.decision: 2020-01-02..2026-11-04（1 656 session）六格：hold_lot/lots = 0.9511（15.1 bp）与 0.9178（200 bp）→ 判据第三支命中，冻结在此窗口输 4.9%/8.2%。三窗口汇总（15.1 bp，入场账本完全相同的两臂）：2015-2019 0.9334、2020-2026 0.9511、2016-2025 1.1458。冻结只在"终点恰为 2025-12-31"那条窗口上赢，同一段 2023-2025 顺风被 2020-2026 窗口包含时反而输——所以符号由窗口终点是否落在漂移资产的高点决定，不由趋势结构决定，更不由政策决定。维护因此是噪声项：三窗口里两负一正，正的那条终点就是面板里的一个局部顶。唯一三窗口同向且量级大的量是闸门下的可表达性：hold@15.1 / hold@200 = 0.666（2016-25）、0.8999（2015-19）、0.8158（2020-26），即 naive 组合在 15.1 bp 下系统性残废 18-33%，因为两个袖买不进去（overseas/commodity 三窗口全部 0.00%、现金 37-41%）。副产品（方法学）：面板覆盖到 2026-11-04，而 REPLAY_END 停在 2025-12-31，项目全部头条数字（lots − static +1,542.79 CNY/yr、5.46% cagr、−14.50% maxDD）都在一个比现有数据短 10 个月的窗口上取得；把同一批臂推到 2026-11-04，冻结变体让出约 5%，说明该终点不是中性截断。
data.rationale: 三窗口把两个候选解释分开：若符号由趋势结构决定，2020-2026（含同一段 2023-2025 顺风）应与 2016-2025 同向，实测反向；若符号由窗口终点决定，则把终点推过该段高点应翻转，实测正是如此（lots@15.1 的 commodity 末权 2.13% vs hold_lot 14.54%，2026 年这段回吐归冻结臂）。因此"冻结/再瞄准"不承载任何可复用信息，而"在 15.1 bp 与 50 000 元下能否把四个袖买进账本"在三窗口都是 18-33% 的差距。这直接回到项目原命题（组成承载风险），并把维护机构降级为未定。会改变判读的观察：若采用臂在 2026 段上不出现任何回撤恶化（即 2026 只伤冻结臂不伤维护臂），则端点效应只作用于漂移臂，前述"终点非中性"需改写为"漂移臂的终点敏感性"。
data.applicability: 50 000 CNY、measured 费率、日频标记口径、三窗口（2015-2019 / 2016-2025 / 2020-2026）、15.1 与 200 bp。2026-11-04 终点超出 REPLAY_END，属诊断读数，不进入评估口径。成员可用性随窗口变化（511380 自 2020-04、512100 自 2016-11），故只读比值不读绝对值。
data.remainingRisk: 2026 段只有 10 个月，样本不足以单独支撑任何结论；"终点效应"目前是三窗口里唯一自洽的解释，但未被独立检验（例如把 2016-2025 窗口的终点逐月前移，看 hold_lot/lots 是否随终点单调变化——那才是对端点假说的直接检验）。
data.verifyPlan: 终点扫描：固定起点 2016-01-04，终点依次取 2023-12-29 / 2024-12-31 / 2025-12-31 / 2026-11-04，跑 lots 与 hold_lot 两臂（8 次 replay，约 40 s），看 hold_lot/lots 是否随终点前移单调下降。
data.reopenCondition: 采用臂（lots@15.1）在 2026-01-01..2026-11-04 段上相对冻结臂不再变差，或第四条窗口上 hold_lot/lots 再次 >1.02 且终点不在 2025-12-31。

data.hypothesis: 冻结相对再瞄准的优势是窗口终点的函数：终点越接近漂移资产（overseas/commodity）的高点，冻结越赢；把终点推过该高点，优势让回。若成立，则 2025-12-31 这个 REPLAY_END 是选中了一个有利终点。
data.candidateId: hold_lot/lots as a function of window end (2023-12-29 / 2024-12-31 / 2025-12-31 / 2026-11-04)
data.decisionRule: 直接检验 seq 163 的端点假说。固定起点 2016-01-04、固定 15.1 bp、固定两臂（lots 与 hold_lot，入场账本完全相同，只差维护成交），终点依次取 2023-12-29 / 2024-12-31 / 2025-12-31 / 2026-11-04，共 8 次 replay（约 40 s）。判据写在跑前：若 hold_lot/lots 随终点前移单调下降（2023 > 2024 > 2025 > 2026 或至少末端显著低于 2025-12-31 值），则冻结优势是终点函数，端点假说成立，seq 163 的"维护是噪声"保留；若各终点比值在 1.0 附近无单调结构而仅 2025-12-31 异常高，则 2025-12-31 是单点伪影，需把该终点从评估口径中撤出；若各终点都 >1.02，则冻结稳定占优、端点假说被否，回到"维护毁值"。
data.notes: explore 步（端点敏感性）：目的不是评估政策而是给 "维护=噪声" 找直接证据。8 次 replay 约 40 秒。

data.hypothesis: 年度再锚定的价值不在收益水平而在入场日期无关性：冻结账本的结果强烈依赖入场日（2016-01-04 入场赢 +20%，2020-01-02 入场输 4.9%），而再锚定账本每年重新校准，因此跨起点色散更小。若如此，构造在 50 000 元上的存在理由是"不赌入场日"，而不是"赚得更多"。
data.baselineId: lots@15.1 与 hold_lot@15.1 在 2016-01-04 起点的 10 年结果
data.candidateId: 入场日期色散：10 个起点 × {lots, hold_lot} @15.1 bp，统一终点 2026-11-04
data.decisionRule: seq 165 否掉端点假说后，候选的新解释是"再锚定买的是入场日期无关性，不是收益"。判据写在跑前：起点取 2016..2025 每年第一个 session（10 个），统一终点 2026-11-04，两臂 lots/hold_lot @15.1 bp，各算年化（(end/50000)^(365.25/days)-1）与日频 maxDD。若 sd(年化) 上 hold_lot > 1.5×lots，则冻结的跨起点色散显著更大、再锚定是入场日期的方差收敛装置 → 构造的理由从"收益"改写为"起点无关性"，这是可测量的存在理由。若两者 sd 相近（<1.5×），则再锚定连起点无关性也不提供，构造退场方向复活。同时报 median 年化差（hold_lot − lots）与 win rate（多少个起点上 hold_lot 赢），以区分"方差差异"与"水平差异"。
data.notes: explore 步：把"存在理由"从收益口径换成色散口径。10 起点 × 2 臂 ≈ 20 次 replay，约 2 分钟。

data.subject: 配对设计结案：冻结 vs 再锚定 = +0.27pp/yr 年化、t=0.78，可忽略；入场日期本身的色散（4.6%–8.8%）比项目争论的全部效应大一个量级
data.decision: 11 个起点（2016..2026 每年首个 session）× {lots, hold_lot} @15.1 bp、统一终点 2026-11-04、配对比较（同一起点两臂，入场账本相同只差维护成交）。有效起点 8 个（≥3 年）：gap = hold_lot − lots 年化，mean +0.2671 pp、sd 0.9685、se 0.3424、t = 0.78、hold_lot 赢 4/8，区间 +1.81pp（2016 起点）到 −0.78pp（2020 起点）。结论：配对设计下"年度再锚定 vs 冻结"是零，之前的 +14.58%（2016-2025 单窗口）与 −6.66%（2015-2019）都是单路径读数、量级 5-15% 的窗口伪影。同时色散统计：lots 年化 4.55%–8.83%（sd 1.55）、hold_lot 3.91%–8.62%（sd 1.72），即同一政策、同一资产、只换入场日的年化区间就有 4.3–4.7pp 宽；2026-01-05 入场至今（10 个月）两臂同为 −6.24%。故预注册判据（sd ratio < 1.5 → 再锚定不提供起点无关性）命中：sd ratio = 1.72/1.55 = 1.11，冻结的跨起点色散略大但不是 1.5 倍。可稳定保留的唯一量仍是闸门下的可表达性（naive 组合在 15.1 bp 下两袖 0% 持有、落后 18-33%）。
data.rationale: 此前三轮读数的符号翻转全部来自"单窗口 + 单起点"：(+14.58% → 0.9334 → 0.9511 → 端点扫描 1.0517→1.2039) 说明每一个都可由窗口或起点移动制造。改成配对设计（同起点两臂相减）后，效应量立刻降到 0.27pp、t=0.78。这说明该项目此前所有"维护有没有价值"的证据都是未配对的，且效应量小于入场日色散一个数量级。判断标准也随之更换：政策比较必须在起点维度上配对或做色散校正，单窗口终值不再能作为结论依据。会改变判读的观察：配对后某条臂的 gap 在 ≥12 个起点上稳定同号且 |mean| > 1pp（此时 t 需 > 3），或某个臂的跨起点 sd 显著低于另一臂（ratio < 0.7），才能说它提供了起点无关性。
data.applicability: 50 000 CNY、15.1 bp、measured 费率、统一终点 2026-11-04、起点为各年首个 session；窗口长度 0.8–10.8 年不等，故只取 ≥3 年的 8 个起点做统计，短窗口（1.8 年及以下）年化不可比、且 2025/2026 起点窗口内没有下一个 1 月，两臂退化相同。2026-11-04 终点超出 REPLAY_END 2025-12-31。
data.remainingRisk: 8 个配对点仍来自同一条 2016-2026 价格路径，配对只消除起点噪声、不消除路径本身；若中国 ETF 的资产类收益结构在这十年里是特例，配对结论同样不外推。短窗口（1.8 年以下）被排除，故"最近一年入场"的证据只有单点 −6.24%，不足以定论。
data.verifyPlan: 按季度取起点（2016Q1..2026Q3，约 43 个起点）跑同两臂，配对 gap 的均值和 t 若仍 ≈0 且 |mean| < 0.5pp，则"维护中性"在样本量上升后依然成立，可作为结案。
data.reopenCondition: 配对 gap 在追加起点（如按季度取起点，样本 30+）上稳定同号且 |mean| > 1pp，或某臂跨起点 sd 比另一臂低 30% 以上。

Annual re-submission is neutral (decision-2be59fdb, adopted seq168): 8 effective entry starts (first session of 2016..2023, window >= 3y, common end 2026-11-04, 15.1 bp) give gap = hold_lot minus lots annualised: mean +0.2671 pp, sd 0.9685, se 0.3424, t = 0.78, hold_lot wins 4/8, per-start +1.81 pp (2016) to -0.78 pp (2020).

Entry-date dispersion is an order of magnitude larger than every effect this project has argued about: same policy, same assets, only the start day changes, and lots annualises 4.55%-8.83% (sd 1.55) while hold_lot annualises 3.91%-8.62% (sd 1.72). A 2026-01-05 entry to 2026-11-04 (10 months) returns -6.24% on both arms (terminal 47,399.33).

Endpoint hypothesis refuted (run-09bb95dc, seq165): fixed start 2016-01-04, both arms at 15.1 bp, ratio hold_lot/lots rises monotonically with the end date 1.0517 (2023-12-29) -> 1.0994 (2024-12-31) -> 1.1458 (2025-12-31) -> 1.2039 (2026-11-04). Once the gate is opened the binding constraint is board-lot granularity, not cost: lots@1000 bp ends at 85,482.62 with 38 suppressions all of reason zero_lot (17 buys, 21 sells), versus 51 suppressions and 85,111.30 at 15.1 bp. Fixing the i+1/i+2 asymmetry at newquant/replay.py:804 therefore buys execution price, not executability, and is not a value repair.

The daily drawdown troughs are in different years: lots -14.50% troughs 2018-12-26 (peak 2018-01-24); hold_lot -14.28% and hold_deploy -17.31% trough 2022-10-28 (peak 2021-12-13). The similar numbers are a coincidence, not one risk expressed twice.

data.hypothesis: The success criterion's simpler-policy branch has never been tested at decision grade: the only paired grid (32 quarterly starts) compared the adopted lots book against hold_lot, which is the same construction frozen, not a simpler policy. The simpler prespecified policy is the declared 45/35/10/10 mandate bought once and held with its real one-off entry cost paid (hold@200bp, measured 0 suppressions, 0.90 bp/yr), and the single 2016 cell already had it ahead of lots@15.1 on terminal, daily vol, daily maxDD and cost simultaneously. Hypothesis: paired across 32 starts, hold@200 is not worse than the adopted book on terminal net CNY and on daily-marked risk at essentially every start, i.e. the construction's existence reason is the per-order gate applied to a one-off build rather than a property of the lot rule.
data.dataVersion: etf_bars_qfq + etf_bars + corp_actions + venue, frozen manifests
data.decisionRule: R0 reproduction: lots@15.1 at every one of the 32 recorded starts must equal evidence/probe-hold-kill/quarterly-paired.json's lots nav to +-0.01; failure means my market-build convention differs and no arm may be quoted. R1 return band one-sided: simpler policy H is not worse at a start when nav_H >= nav_lots*(1-0.02); a two-sided band would score a simpler policy that beats the adopted book by >2% as a failure and invert the criterion. R2 risk band: daily maxDD_H >= mdd_lots-1.0pp AND daily vol_H <= vol_lots+1.0pp. R3 a start passes when R1 and R2 all hold. Branch A (construction retires): >=30 of 32 starts pass AND paired mean annualised gap >= 0. Branch B (construction has a measured reason): <20 of 32 pass, or H is worse than the band at >=8 starts. Branch C: 20-29 pass -> unresolved, report the 2x2 attribution and decide nothing. Secondary attribution only: factorial means of {lots,hold}x{15.1,200}; if hold@15.1/hold@200 stays near the single-cell 0.666 at most starts, the gate alone explains the adopted-vs-naive gap.
data.notes: explore/screen on the 32 quarterly windows already observed by run-5a92eb45 (endpoint 2026-11-04); a final claim will need an unread window set. Inline probe, no prototype: probe/retirement_dominance.py, throws away after it answers.

data.subject: Does the prespecified simpler policy (mandate bought once at a fair gate) dominate the adopted book at every entry start?
data.decision: Branch B. hold@200 (declared 45/35/10/10 bought once, paying its real ~20 CNY entry) does NOT dominate the adopted lots@15.1: it passes the three-part criterion at 5/32 quarterly starts, is worse on terminal NAV at 29/32, paired annualised gap mean -0.918 pp (sd 0.586, se 0.104, t -8.86, 95% CI [-1.121,-0.715]), and is 1.26-4.58 pp WORSE on daily maxDD at the 16 starts where R2 fails (mostly 2020-2023 entries). R1 fails at 27 starts (gap -2.4% to -9.0%). So the success criterion's first branch (retire the construction) is closed on this window: the construction has a measured reason to exist. Attribution: loosening the gate from 15.1 to 200 bp destroys value for the adopted construction at 32/32 starts (lots@15.1/lots@200 mean 1.0437, min 1.0053, max 1.0899); the gate cripples the naive arm (hold@15.1/hold@200 mean 0.7928, 0/32 above 1, because two of four sleeves cannot be expressed and 37-41% of the book stays in cash); with the gate open the naive arm beats the lot construction (hold@200/hold_lot@200 mean 1.0194, 31/32); at the same gate, maintenance vs frozen is a coin flip (lots@15.1/hold_lot@15.1 mean 0.9810, 17/32).
data.rationale: The rule was pre-declared at seq 179 before any number; R0 reproduced both recorded arms to 0.00 CNY at 32/32 starts, so the build convention matches and the arms are quotable. The criterion is one-sided on return (a simpler policy beating the book is not a failure) and two-sided on risk, so a -0.92 pp mean with t -8.86 is not a tolerance reading.
data.applicability: 32 quarterly entry starts 2016-01-04..2023-10-09, endpoint 2026-11-04, NAV0 50000 CNY, cost measured per code, gate 15.1 bp vs 200 bp, member order as in newquant/replay.py:57-63. Screen only - windows already observed by run-5a92eb45; a final claim needs an unread window.
data.remainingRisk: One window (2026-11-04 endpoint), one NAV (50k), one cost mode. The screen reuses windows already observed, so the gap size is in-sample. The attribution below says the gap may be a member-ordering artifact rather than a mechanism, which would make 'the construction earns something' the wrong reading even though Branch B is correct as stated.
data.verifyPlan: Member-order permutation on the overseas sleeve (3! = 6) at 6 starts, 2 arms: if the paired gap flips sign or the mean collapses to the inside of the band, Branch B stands as a statement about this member order, not about the construction.

data.subject: Where does the adopted book's measured edge over the naive policy come from?
data.decision: The overseas sleeve at 15.1 bp is not equal-weighted nor chosen by any stated criterion: `lot_composition` drops member count k until the per-member slice clears the floor and keeps the PREFIX `available[:k]` (newquant/replay.py:401,403), so at 50 000 CNY the 10% overseas budget (5 000) clears the floor only at k=1 and the whole sleeve lands on `SLEEVE_MEMBERS["overseas"][0]` = 513100. 2017-04-05 start, split-adjusted terminal weights: hold_lot@15.1 513100 31.7% / 518880 16.5% / no bond, cash 25.4%, nav 84 794; hold@200 (all three overseas members) 513100 11.6% + 513500 6.7% + 159920 2.2%, gold 17.4%, bond 13.5%, cash 18.0%, nav 77 511; lots@15.1 (both bond members after 2020) bond 31.9%, overseas 17.8%, nav 84 518. Measured qfq CAGR 2017-04-05..2026-11-04: 513100 19.77%, 513500 13.42%, 518880 11.94%, 159934 11.86%, 511220 4.73%, 510300 4.05%, 511380 2.41%, 510500 1.83%, 159920 1.12%, 512100 0.37%. A 100%-513100 overseas sleeve versus an equal split of the same three is worth about +2.2 pp/yr of portfolio return over this window, i.e. more than the -0.918 pp/yr the screen measured. Suspicion: the construction's measured edge over the naive policy is the prefix rule landing on the window's best member, not implementability machinery.
data.rationale: The reconstruction is exact (fill records + corp split ratios + last mark prices reproduce nav to the cent), but it rests on ONE start so far, and 513100's advantage over 159920 is a property of this window rather than a law. If the same reconstruction at other starts shows the sleeve lands on whichever code sorts first, the concentration is a rule artifact; if the gap survives reordering, the prefix happens to be harmless and the construction keeps a real reason.
data.remainingRisk: Shrinking k is itself defensible engineering (a 2 500 CNY order cannot amortise a 5 CNY commission); the artifact claim is only about WHICH member survives, not about k-shrinking existing. A permutation that leaves the edge intact would say the window's overseas winner did not drive the measured gap, and then the residual cash deployment is the real reason.
data.verifyPlan: Permute SLEEVE_MEMBERS["overseas"] over its 6 orderings at 6 starts, arms lots@15.1 and hold@200: if the paired gap mean stays <= -0.6 pp under all 6 orderings the edge is not order-driven (residual-cash deployment is then the candidate), and if some ordering puts the simpler policy ahead the edge is the prefix landing on 513100.

data.subject: Is the construction's edge a rule or the member that sorts first?
data.decision: The adopted construction's measured advantage over the naive policy is the identity of `SLEEVE_MEMBERS["overseas"][0]`, not a mechanism. Six orderings of ("513100","513500","159920"), 6 starts, arms lots@15.1 vs hold@200, endpoint 2026-11-04: mean paired gap -0.776 (513100 first), -0.738 (513100,159920,513500), -0.359 (513500 first), -0.334 (513500,159920,513100), +0.968 (159920 first, both orders identical because k=1 keeps a single member). Spread 1.743 pp/yr, nearly twice the -0.918 pp the seq-181 screen measured; grand mean -0.045 pp/yr, i.e. inside the pre-declared [-0.6,0] band. With 159920 first the simpler policy is ahead at 6/6 starts (+0.349 to +1.738 pp/yr, ratios 1.014-1.205); with 513100 first it is ahead at 1/6. Every cell bought exactly ONE overseas code, so the sleeve is a single-fund bet by construction at this NAV, and the fund is chosen by tuple position. Both pre-declared artifact conditions fired.
data.rationale: P0 held at 0.00 CNY on both arms at all 6 starts, so the monkeypatch is the same experiment and the orderings differ only in what the prefix rule may buy. The sign flip is not a rounding effect: it comes with a 20% terminal-NAV difference at 2016-01-04 (70 689 vs 85 201), and the two 159920-first orderings are bit-identical to each other, which is what a k=1 prefix rule must produce.
data.remainingRisk: The 6 orderings are 6 of the ways to be arbitrary; equity (3 members) and commodity (2 members) orders were not permuted, so the total exposure to ordering is at least this large. data.subject: What does the failed retirement criterion actually license?
data.decision: The seq-181 screen stands only as a statement about the tuple as shipped: at 50 000 CNY a four-sleeve 45/35/10/10 mandate is not implementable, and the construction's edge over the naive policy is a single-fund pick that the prefix rule makes without any stated criterion. Arithmetic: the overseas sleeve budget is 5 000 CNY and the 15.1 bp gate is 3 311 CNY per order, so k=2 needs 2 500 per member and fails; every permuted cell bought exactly one overseas code. Consequently the success criterion cannot be decided on the shipped construction, because the object under test is not uniquely defined - reordering the tuple moves the paired gap from -0.78 to +0.97 pp/yr at the same 6 starts, with the simpler policy ahead 6/6 in the favourable ordering and 1/6 in the shipped one. Neither arm holds the mandate it declares: across the 32 starts, terminal bond is 29.6% (lots@15.1) vs 15.3% (hold@200) against a declared 35%, equity 35.2% vs 33.4% against 45%, cash 14.6% vs 17.3%. Cash is not the channel: mean entry cash is 22.4% (lots) vs 18.2% (hold@200) and corr(delta entry cash, gap) = -0.007; the channel that tracks the gap is the overseas terminal weight, corr = +0.745, with equity weight -0.637.
data.rationale: The composition table is computed from the monthly realised_* columns of the 192-cell retirement grid, and the gate arithmetic from code_gate/sleeve_floor with measured slippage; both are re-derivable without replay. The retirement question is not answered by choosing a better tuple - that would be fitting the window - so the question has to be restated at the level of which book is holdable at this capital.
data.applicability: NAV0 50 000 CNY, gate 15.1 bp, cost mode measured, member universe newquant/replay.py:57-63, 32 quarterly starts 2016-01-04..2023-10-09 with 6 of them permuted, endpoint 2026-11-04. Holds for any account whose sleeve budget divided by member count falls below max(gate, one board lot) - at 50 000 CNY that is the overseas sleeve (5 000/2 = 2 500 < 3 311 gate) and, before 2020-04-07, the bond sleeve (17 500 with one listed member). And 'unholdable' means the declared vector cannot be expressed at this NAV, not that no book of four funds exists - a different declared vector is a different question.

data.subject: Was the shipped ordering recoverable by an entry-date rule?
data.decision: The shipped tuple's advantage is not recoverable by a stated rule, so it is a fitted choice and the retirement criterion's Branch B does not generalise. Ranking overseas members by median turnover over the 120 sessions before each entry puts 159920 first at 6/6 starts, and the resulting nav is bit-identical to the 159920-first ordering at 6/6 (70 689 / 67 967 / 73 507 / 67 336 / 57 634 / 61 909 against the shipped 81 605 / 84 518 / 82 583 / 77 353 / 62 773 / 65 326). So the deepest market is exactly the fund that lost, and any rule that could have named 513100 would have had to name it for its past returns. Consequence: 'SLEEVE_MEMBERS["overseas"][0] = 513100' is a return-based choice presented as an implementation detail; the construction as shipped is not a policy that can be stated before its window, so the seq-181 Branch B cannot be carried forward as evidence that the lot machinery earns anything.
data.rationale: The kill condition was on disk before the run and fired at its strongest value (6/6, not the 4/6 needed). Identity to the worst ordering is exact rather than approximate, which is what a k=1 prefix rule must give, so the result is not a near-miss to be re-tuned with another lookback or another liquidity statistic.
data.applicability: Same as mandate-unholdable-at-50k: NAV0 50 000 CNY, gate 15.1 bp, cost measured, 6 starts 2016-01-04..2023-10-09, endpoint 2026-11-04, universe newquant/replay.py:57-63. The claim is about the *overseas* sleeve only; the equity sleeve does not bind at k=3 in this NAV range, and the bond sleeve binds only before 2020-04-07.
data.remainingRisk: Only one rule family was tried (turnover), and a different ex-ante statistic (tracking error, fee, index breadth, AUM at entry) could name a different fund - but any of those would still have to name 513100 to recover the edge, and none of them is obviously aligned with a Nasdaq proxy over a Hang Seng proxy. The conclusion is that the shipped tuple is not *recovered* by a rule, not that no rule exists.
data.verifyPlan: Run the same rule at 100 000 CNY, where the overseas sleeve clears the gate at k=2 and the tuple position stops deciding the fund: if the liquidity rule and the shipped tuple converge there, the artifact is capital-specific and the frontier statement is about capital, not about ordering.
data.reopenCondition: A published, entry-date-observable criterion that ranks 513100 first among {513100, 513500, 159920} would reopen this; so would a window in which 159920 outperforms, which would show the ordering lottery is symmetric rather than fitted.

data.rationale: 符号规则的门槛（22/32）按预注册执行，未过；但相关 −0.56/−0.57 在 n=32 上 t≈−3.7 不能当噪声。两者并存的读法是：gap 的期望随入场估值单调下降，但由于单个起点的 gap sd 0.84 pp 远大于该斜率可解释的部分，符号仍不可判。会改变判读的观察：把样本扩到 40 个独立起点后反向命中仍 ≥ 24/32，才说明符号可判。
data.applicability: 32 个季度起点、50 000 CNY、15.1 bp、同一条 2016-2026 中国 ETF 路径。三变量均在入场日可观测（trailing 3 年实现超额、60 日实现波动、os+cm 相对 basket 的 5 年 z 值），无前视。阈值（relz 中位数 +1.389）是样本内选的。

data.subject: Expressibility frontier: which sleeves are prefix-bound, and at what capital they stop
data.decision: The overseas sleeve cannot be order-free anywhere inside the account's 50 000-100 000 CNY range: C* = 133 080 CNY (3 members x 4 436 CNY per-order floor / 0.10 weight). Below ~88 720 CNY it holds exactly ONE member, so the tuple order picks the fund; between ~88 720 and 133 080 it holds TWO of three, so the order picks the pair. The other sleeves clear inside the range (commodity order-free from 80 000, bond from 60 000, equity order-free at every start from 50 000).
data.rationale: Closed form: a sleeve is order-free iff w*NAV/len(available) >= sleeve_floor(available), so C* = len*floor/w. The overseas three-member floor is 4 436 CNY per order (not the 3 311 the handoff quotes, which omits that floor is a max over the codes' own gates), so C*_overseas = 3*4 436/0.10 = 133 080. The account's stated top of range, 100 000, sits below it: at 100k overseas holds 2 of 3, not 3 of 3. What would change it: a different gate, a different sleeve weight, or a member list with cheaper per-order floors.
data.applicability: Board lot 100 shares, 15.1 bp gate, cost mode measured, slippage frozen per code over 2016-01-04..2026-11-04, entered at NAV = capital. Applies to any capital <= 133 080 CNY; above that the overseas sleeve is order-free.
supersedes: seq 186 applicability note "stops holding at roughly 100 000 CNY, where the overseas budget clears the gate at k=2"
data.reopenCondition: If the gate tightens, the overseas weight rises, or the sleeve gains a member with a lower per-order floor, C* moves and the 50-100k statement must be recomputed.

data.subject: How much the overseas ordering lottery costs at 100 000 vs 50 000 CNY
data.decision: Raising capital from 50 000 to 100 000 CNY nearly halves the overseas ordering lottery: mean paired gap per ordering falls from a spread of 1.743 pp/yr to 0.736 pp/yr (grand mean -0.045 -> -0.159 pp/yr, hold@200 ahead in 1-5 of 6 starts depending on ordering). The residual 0.74 pp spread is still ~4.6x the -0.159 pp mean, so the object stays undecidable at 100k; and every 100k ordering eventually buys all three members, so the spread at 100k comes from the PATH (which two of three are bought first, and when the third joins), not from the terminal member count.
data.rationale: The 100k grid is a screen with no reproduction anchor (the only recorded reference grid is at 50 000), so its absolute levels are unverified; what it establishes is the ORDERING SPREAD at a second capital, which is an internal contrast across six identical-except-order cells. The 50k arms reproduced run-39aad9d7 to 0.00 CNY at 6/6 x 2 as recorded. What would change the reading: a reproduction anchor at 100k, or a member list whose floors differ enough that k stops rising with NAV.
data.applicability: Same six starts, endpoint 2026-11-04, cost mode measured, 6 orderings of (513100,513500,159920), lots@15.1 vs hold@200. Applies to this member list and this window only.
data.reopenCondition: If a 100k reproduction anchor appears, or C* is recomputed for a different member list, re-run the six orderings before quoting the spread.

data.subject: Sleeve member count is set by realised NAV, so the book changes object over one account's life
data.decision: The number of members a sleeve holds is a function of the NAV PATH, not of the declared weights and the entry capital: at 50 000 CNY the overseas sleeve enters at one member but two of the six orderings end the decade holding two (`513100-513500-159920` buys 513100+513500 at 3 of the first 3 starts; `159920-513500-513100` never leaves one), and at 100 000 CNY every ordering ends holding all three. So a specification that fixes "one fund per sleeve" is wrong past the first bull market, and one that lets the count float makes the object depend on realised returns - which is why the paired grid cannot decide the criterion even after capital is raised.
data.rationale: `available[:k]` is chosen from the budget at each re-target, and the budget is weight x current NAV, so k is monotone in NAV up to len(available). Observed: 513100-513500-159920 holds two at 2016/2017/2018 starts; 159920-513500-513100 holds one throughout; at 100k all six orderings reach three. What would change it: a re-target rule that pins the member set once and never adds, or a member list whose floors dominate the weight so k cannot rise.
data.applicability: The six permutation starts and the 32-entry-start grid; board lot 100, gate 15.1 bp, measured cost. Does not apply where a sleeve's members trade in lots small enough that many members clear at 50k.
data.reopenCondition: If the book pins its member set at entry (no adding on growth), the path dependence claim no longer applies to that book and must be re-measured on it.

I’ll check the workspace evidence and closest prior work, focusing on whether this adds a contribution beyond known portfolio cardinality and transaction-cost results. I’ll also separate what the ordering spread says about policy specification from what it says about returns.The entry probe explicitly says “no deployment feedback,” so it cannot establish the claim about member counts changing along a portfolio’s full path. Also, a deterministic policy can validly choose its holding count from NAV; the specification gap is the unstated ordering and selection rule. I only have the pasted excerpts here, so I’ll mark claims that need the omitted files or full papers as unverified.1. **The problem is worth solving for this paper account; the proposed contribution is not yet established.** An unstated member-selection rule prevents a reproducible policy comparison. That matters to whoever must decide whether to retain the construction at 50,000–100,000 CNY: the reported historical result changes materially across choices that the specification currently leaves open (`evidence/probe-member-order/report.md:16`).

   However, **a holding count that changes with NAV does not make a policy a different object across starts**. A policy can consistently map current NAV, prices, existing holdings and available instruments into a target portfolio. The missing specification is that mapping, including selection and tie-breaking. Calling the object “undecidable” overstates the problem.

   **The reported 1.743 / 0.736 pp/yr is not yet a magnitude on which the account’s performance decision can rest.** The 50k figure supports treating specification uncertainty as material; it is neither an expected cost nor an achievable improvement. The 100k figure remains less secure because its summary and reproduction evidence are not supplied here. Neither a range-to-mean ratio nor its decline with capital establishes decision relevance. What matters is whether fully specified, comparable policies change the account decision.

   This assessment uses the supplied excerpts. Omitted file contents, ledger records and external full texts remain unverified.

2. **The two probes establish different things; the earlier project history cannot be reconstructed from these excerpts.**

   - **Expressibility probe:** it tested an entry-time closed form against session-0 fills, reporting “12/12 agree” (`evidence/probe-expressibility/report.md:5`). That supports agreement with the implemented entry allocator. Its explicit scope is “entry-time only; NAV = capital, no deployment feedback” (`evidence/probe-expressibility/report.md:3`). It does not establish a feasibility boundary throughout a portfolio path, or prove that another allocation method could not admit a different member set.
   - **Member-order probe:** it varied member ordering and reported a grand mean of −0.045 pp/yr and a range of 1.743 pp (`evidence/probe-member-order/report.md:16`). This establishes historical sensitivity under the tested implementation. It does not identify how much comes from trading constraints, different underlying exposures, or other implementation choices.
   - **Earlier screen, run-39aad9d7:** **cannot judge — because the actual policy, comparator, output and failure analysis in `record:189`, `record:190`, and `record:191` are not supplied.** The caller reports −0.9179 pp/yr over 27 starts. A different construction or start set need not reproduce the later result; reconciliation requires identifying those differences.

   There is also an arithmetic issue with saying the earlier estimate “sits inside the band.” A width alone cannot establish containment. If the displayed **+0.968** is the same statistic whose range is **1.743**, the lower endpoint must be at least **−0.775**, which would exclude **−0.9179** (`evidence/probe-member-order/report.md:13`; `evidence/probe-member-order/report.md:16`). The omitted column headers and endpoints are needed to resolve that conditional contradiction.

3. **This is not literally Baule’s \(n^*\), but that distinction does not establish novelty.** On the supplied description, Baule chooses an optimal cardinality through an objective and transaction costs. Your proposed count is an implementation or feasibility restriction under prescribed sleeve budgets. An optimum and a feasibility limit are different mathematical objects.

   For the **lot-feasibility mechanism**, a closer prior-art lead is **R. Mansini and M. G. Speranza, “Heuristic algorithms for the portfolio selection problem with minimum transaction lots,” European Journal of Operational Research 114(2), 219–233 (1999)**. Its subject already places budget-constrained portfolio selection with minimum transaction lots in the established literature. I have not inspected its full formulation here, so whether it contains your exact sleeve constraints is **cannot judge**. Baule, *OR Spectrum* 32:61–76, remains the directly supplied comparator for capital, transaction costs and optimal holding count.

   Fixing sleeve weights adds allocation constraints to a familiar discrete portfolio problem. The distinction “weights prescribed rather than optimized” is therefore insufficient as the contribution claim. Nor is expressing sensitivity in pp/yr itself new: that is a useful reporting unit for a conventional sensitivity analysis.

4. **A contribution could land in a carefully identified empirical result about policy specification at small account sizes.** The defensible claim would be: realistic trading constraints cause economically consequential member-selection dependence under fixed sleeve mandates, and that dependence changes a decision after exposure differences and implementation artifacts have been accounted for.

   Three things would have to hold:

   - **The claimed boundary must describe feasibility, rather than only the prefix allocator.** With a common mandatory minimum ticket \(f\), \(k f\leq wC\) gives the stated bound. With instrument-specific minimum tickets \(m_i\), aggregate entry feasibility instead requires \(\sum_{i\in S}m_i\leq wC\), before further constraints. Equal member targets introduce additional conditions. The definition of `floor_instrument` must make clear which case applies. A suppressed new order also does not automatically make an existing holding infeasible.
   - **The measured spread must isolate the proposed mechanism.** If order changes which market exposures enter the sleeve, the range may principally measure alternative investment choices. A constrained-versus-relaxed comparison must show what the lot and gate add. The 15.1 bp gate must retain its actual suppression semantics throughout.
   - **The result must alter an account decision.** Report the endpoints and paired policy differences against a common comparator. Show whether plausible, specified selectors reverse the verdict or exceed a prespecified materiality threshold. An average across permutations has no decision interpretation until there is a reason to assign those permutations probabilities.

   The present entry check and ordering range support investigating this claim, but do not yet establish it (`evidence/probe-expressibility/report.md:5`; `evidence/probe-member-order/report.md:16`). A result confined to these ETFs and this recorded history could still be a useful project contribution; a broader theoretical claim would require more.

5. **I would abandon this direction as a contribution if a corrected, matched replay showed that every admissible member-selection policy gives the same account decision, with the remaining ordering range below a prespecified economic tolerance at both capital levels.** In particular, if the current large range disappears after aligning the comparator, starts and annualization, the central justification would have failed. Specify the selector and continue the account evaluation.

   The fall from 1.743 to 0.736 pp/yr alone would **not** overturn the direction. A constraint mechanism should weaken as capital makes more members affordable. Likewise, confinement to smaller sleeves limits the scope of the claim; it does not refute it.

6. **The narrow paper-account investigation appears deliverable with the existing replay machinery; its fit to an actual deadline is cannot judge.** The excerpts demonstrate an entry probe and an ordering replay, but provide no runtime, hardware or time budget (`evidence/probe-expressibility/report.md:5`; `evidence/probe-member-order/report.md:16`).

   The **single requirement that forces the design** is an explicit, deterministic mapping from portfolio state to target members and orders at every re-target. That mapping must include member selection, tie-breaking, existing holdings and gate suppression. It makes the policy the same object across starts while allowing its holdings to change.

   The cheapest useful next experiment reuses the recorded market build: reconcile the earlier screen on its overlapping starts, then replay the overseas permutations at both capital levels under the actual constraints and a relaxed-feasibility control. Report paired differences and range endpoints. Establish a reproduction anchor for 100k before relying on its reported level. No new market data are needed for that diagnostic; inference beyond this historical build remains a separate question.

data.subject: Does the ordering spread come from the board lot, the cost gate, or exposure choice?
data.decision: The cost gate is the sole creator of the overseas ordering freedom at 50 000 CNY. Across-orderings dispersion of terminal NAV, six orderings x six starts, pre-declared before the run: base (tol 15.1 bp, floor max(gate, one lot)) 12.643 %, lot_off (gate only, board lot ignored in the count) 12.646 %, gate_off (tol 1e6 bp, lot term only) 0.000 %, free (neither) 0.000 %. Under gate_off and free all six orderings are bit-identical in terminal NAV and in realised sleeve weight; the gap-to-hold means are -0.135 (gate_off) and -0.143 (free) with spread 0.000. Base reproduces the recorded six ordering means exactly (max |diff| 0.0000 pp): -0.776 / -0.738 / -0.359 / -0.334 / +0.968 / +0.968, spread 1.743. The transmission channel is exposure: realised overseas end weight spans 0.0635-0.1781 across orderings in base and is 0.112 for every ordering in gate_off, so the exposure divergence is the mechanism, not an alternative cause - removing the gate removes both together. The board lot contributes 0.003 pp of a 12.6 % spread, i.e. nothing, for this sleeve.
data.rationale: This answers direction-review objection R2 (round round-6f4b2aac): a constrained-vs-relaxed control was required and now exists. It also tells a spec rewrite what it must specify - the member rule - because the ordering freedom is a property of the fee gate at this capital, not of the funds. Run was ad hoc: pre-declaration is in the script docstring, no run_start record precedes it, so the numbers are cited through this fact rather than through a run id.

Per start the composition rows run 11 / 9 / 8 / 7 / 5 / 3 for starts 2016-01-04 / 2017-04-05 / 2018-07-02 / 2020-01-02 / 2021-10-08 / 2023-10-09. The path version with the row's own aimed_overseas weight agrees 43/43 as well, because every composition row is an annual month and the lots arm's target weight there is exactly MANDATE["overseas"] - the two forms coincide on this arm and cannot be separated by it.

I’ll check the workspace, literature, and package registries, focusing on what the control establishes and whether specifying a member rule adds a contribution beyond known fixed-cost portfolio selection.
This session exposes no search, filesystem, or source-reader tools, so I can’t perform the requested searches or verify the cited files. I’ll distinguish the supplied evidence from claims that remain unverified.

The main contribution issue is already visible: a rule’s result falling inside the six-ordering band is a consistency check. It doesn’t establish the rule’s value, and the reported 1.743 pp/yr range of ordering means cannot serve as every start’s band width.1. **Yes, it is worth a small policy-specification experiment.** For the research and paper accounts, the reported failure is that tuple order determines which economically distinct overseas exposure survives the cost gate. That makes an implementation choice consequential. The reported 1.743 pp/yr is a historical range across ordering means, however, not an achievable improvement or the measured cost of the current deployed policy. The supplied material does not establish what an actual account has lost. The gate-relaxed control supports investigating this sensitivity under the recorded constraints; it does not establish a general investment advantage. Citation: record:m00427, “Gate relaxed: all six orderings bit-identical (dispersion 0.000 %), gap -0.135 pp/yr vs hold, so the 1.743 pp freedom exists only while the gate truncates the sleeve to one fund.”

2. **The supplied record describes five earlier attempts; I cannot verify their files or reconstruct additional projects.** Version 1 proposed `C* = len(available)*floor/w` without identifying the constraint responsible; the ablation now attributes the reported count restriction to the gate. Citation: record:m00427, “Earlier version claimed the count as C* = len(available)*floor/w and left the cause unattributed”. The earlier return screen produced −0.9179 pp/yr on a different start set and was withdrawn, teaching that unmatched start sets cannot price this choice. Citation: record:m00427, “The earlier screen's -0.9179 pp/yr lies 0.142 pp below the worst ordering mean on a different start set and is withdrawn.” The turnover rule selected 159920 and ranked worst at all six starts; this demonstrates that a computable pre-window criterion need not preserve return performance. Citation: record:m00427, “The only pre-window criterion on record (median turnover, prior 120 sessions) picks 159920 and lands on the worst ordering at 6/6 starts.” The four-regime control reportedly reproduced the recorded ordering means and reduced dispersion to zero when the gate was relaxed; removing lots barely changed dispersion. Citation: record:m00427, “Board lot contributes 0.003 pp of a 12.643 % dispersion (lot_off 12.646 %), so this is a fee-schedule story, not a lot story.” Finally, the path check supports the count claim at the recorded annual composition dates, with no monthly-rebalancing result. Citation: record:m00427, “The count law is confirmed at 43 annual composition month-ends only; a monthly-rebalancing arm is untested.”

3. **Cannot judge whether Baule is the closest work overall, because the required independent searches and source readings could not be performed in this session.** No browser, registry, filesystem, or delegated-reader tools are exposed. Baule is the closest substantive theoretical comparator documented in the supplied record: its fixed-fee region and capital-to-cardinality results already cover the broad mechanism “transaction costs constrain diversification,” including cases without lots. The claimed contribution cannot be that mechanism alone. Also, the supplied inference that absence of lots removes the member-selection question is unsupported: fixed transaction costs can make both the number and identity of selected assets consequential. The paper’s body must settle what its selection model actually includes. Within the workspace, the reported gate implementations in `newquant/order.py:84` and `newquant/replay.py:363` are the closest implementation antecedents, but these locations have not been inspected. Citation: record:m00427. The PRIOR entries below therefore reflect supplied summaries, not completed novelty searches or independent body reads.

4. **A contribution could land in making an implicit execution policy explicit and measuring its consequences.** It would connect gate-induced cardinality to tuple-dependent member identity, then replace that dependency with a reproducible rule using information available before investment. For this to count beyond ordinary fixed-cost portfolio selection, the comparison must establish that existing methods or documentation leave this decision unspecified, and that the rule adds a useful, holdable specification. It need not beat the hindsight winner, but its economic justification must survive knowing its measured cost. Report each start’s regret, \(r_s=\max_o g_{o,s}-g_{\text{rule},s}\), where \(g\) is the annualized gap against the same hold benchmark. Neither a rule’s switching across starts nor a large ordering spread establishes novelty. The strongest contribution objection is that an arbitrary deterministic priority plus retrospective pricing may be a useful engineering deliverable while adding no new selection method. Citation: record:m00427, “Deliverable is a specified holdable policy, not a better backtest”.

5. **A gate-feasible two-member annual target at 50,000 CNY under the recorded engine, data, weight, and 15.1 bp gate would directly overturn the count claim.** A reproduced ordering-dependent result with the gate disabled would overturn the reported attribution. Separately, I would end the search for a more elaborate selector if, on genuinely uninspected starts, one fixed eligible fund stayed within the declared 0.2 pp/yr tolerance of the best ordering at every start: adopt that simple policy and stop searching. That would not erase the historical six-start spread; it would defeat the case for further selection machinery. The proposed “every admissible rule agrees” result is decisive only if “admissible” is defined independently and comprehensively. Agreement among a few chosen heuristics does not show that the choice is forced. Citation: record:m00427, “A result where every admissible rule lands on the same ordering would show the choice is forced and the direction has no content.”

6. **The reported system can plausibly deliver the narrow annual policy without new machinery; independent execution feasibility remains unverified.** The single requirement that forces the design is that the member choice be computable from the available data before the investment date. The already measured turnover rule is evidence of one feasible implementation. Listing-date and tracking-error-disclosure rules are not established as feasible from the named parquet files; the record expressly excludes external data acquisition. For a member fixed for each replay, existing per-ordering results may already price the rule without additional replays, once equivalence to the selected one-member path is established. Annual reselection would require accounting for member changes and their execution costs. The six-start screen is affordable on the reported compute budget, but it cannot supply independent validation after being inspected. Nor does the stated one-member result cover the entire 50–100k range: its own assumption stops below 88,720 CNY.
